### 2026-10-24 – I completely made my schematic and my pcb! i routed everything and 0 errors, so yay!!!

**7h**

I completely made my schematic and my pcb! i routed everything and 0 errors, so yay!!!

![Screenshot 2026-10-24 at 10.50.09 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/NBJ0hooRCzpXBFkBB07YJmm7WhL2zJ1p/d8a86ad88a5ebcd9092eafbaa7cbbea4ff686fb90545a1523e18272734f663f7.png)
![Screenshot 2026-10-24 at 10.50.23 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/NBJ0hooRCzpXBFkBB07YJmm7WhL2zJ1p/fd816940f5ceafd963a48995843526551cafea7283607ceb1b012c10683f8c01.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/NBJ0hooRCzpXBFkBB07YJmm7WhL2zJ1p/7fac463d5bf4a909c06b9e08bd845b1ac3428821a117e84594e1ee577d7471b9.png)
I have 2 other boards I need to make. one will look like this:
![Screenshot 2026-10-24 at 10.51.16 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/NBJ0hooRCzpXBFkBB07YJmm7WhL2zJ1p/f6e8f6ded30c0a5fa100a855a2470bf8c7c1d784025d4f1ccf0ce65a26794a1d.png)
and the other will be this same board just with the first 5 keys so everything connects nicely. The 3 pin connectors on the end are for Modular Side Connectors, so that the boards can connect together and communicate. I found a nice one from adafruit that i plan to use :)

![Screenshot 2026-10-24 at 10.52.48 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/NBJ0hooRCzpXBFkBB07YJmm7WhL2zJ1p/a849eebd8ec1a094a47850041ab36ad0119d1797613b0b4b9c20d8ef1550bb29.png)
This is the render. I am using 2 audio jacks, one for a midi jack and one as a headphone jack :)

![Screenshot 2026-10-24 at 10.54.00 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/NBJ0hooRCzpXBFkBB07YJmm7WhL2zJ1p/17419ef59abe867736216898e635fb881ebc02163dc017968f8ecdc8b457d10d.png) I also made a custom footprint to correspond to the 7 piano keys, lookie!!

Overall, I think i did really good today, and I plan to do more work :D

**3h**

![Screenshot 2026-10-24 at 11.50.55 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/NBJ0hooRCzpXBFkBB07YJmm7WhL2zJ1p/ceb77deabef69cd904b08c0debeb6d5f0093e1e1e389b3ff62ddf1743923f272.png)
![Screenshot 2026-10-24 at 11.51.52 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/NBJ0hooRCzpXBFkBB07YJmm7WhL2zJ1p/6bb14368253a2711a0dff48aee9d8991375463fd9e3062c1e32c8c42840f8a42.png)
![Screenshot 2026-10-24 at 11.52.17 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/NBJ0hooRCzpXBFkBB07YJmm7WhL2zJ1p/e398827f77e7f7394a9cc2ee6be2566619758a3c2c995d8a58bd8ecffc987d0b.png)
The 5 key version is finished! I know 3 hours seems like a stupidly long time to just edit, but I ran into a lot of errors. First of all, I uploaded the old key files to the GitHub repo so I can just edit the old versions, which should theoretically work! But when deleting things not needed on this side of the board (like audio jacks and extra keys), I ran into quite a few issues when routing. Updating the footprint was weird as well, because the old 7-key version wasn't completely updated and had a new version that was a different size, and I had to deal with that by fishing out the old version and just deleting the 2 keys. However, it's all done now! I just need to make the SYNTH part of the board to connect :>

i spent a bit of time (30ish minutes) researching what I should have in my synth board, and then i found parts and modeled it off of the image i sent earlier, the Roland DJ-808. I have a couple of connectors so they can connect to the other boards and for an LCD and a circular touchpad (like a vinyl you can swipe :3) but for the most part I made the barebone schematic and assigned footprints. I also made the switch matrix, and I will wire the rest later.
